venue: Piano Man at Miracle Mile Shops at Planet Hollywood

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP is the orange section closest to the stage. Because the room is narrow, these seats stay centered while putting you nearer to the piano, band and dancers.

zones.label: General Admission
zones.description: General Admission sits directly behind VIP. The narrow layout keeps this section centered on the stage, giving you a straight-on view from farther back.
